Dominica , [ a ] officially the Commonwealth of Dominica , [ b ] is an island country in the Caribbean . [ 16 ] It is part of the Windward Islands chain in the Lesser Antilles archipelago in the Caribbean Sea . The capital, Roseau , is located on the western side of the island. Dominica's closest neighbours are two constituent territories of the European Union , both overseas departments of France: Guadeloupe to the northwest and Martinique to the south-southeast. Dominica comprises a land area of 750 km 2 (290 sq mi), and the highest point is Morne Diablotins , at 1,448 m (4,751 ft) in elevation. The population was 71,293 at the 2011 census. [ 8 ]
